sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是百分之九十九隐形。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The largest body of water in California was formed by mistake.
sentences.zh: 加州最大的水体其实是一场失误造成的。

sentences.en: In 1905, the California Development Company accidentally flooded a huge salty depression
sentences.zh: 1905年，加州开发公司不小心淹没了一个巨大的咸水洼地，

sentences.en: in the Sonoran Desert known as the Salton Sink,
sentences.zh: 位于索诺兰沙漠，被称为索尔顿盆地，

sentences.en: creating an enormous salty lake called the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 形成了一个名为索尔顿海的巨大咸水湖。

sentences.en: And here we are at the edge of the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 现在我们来到了索尔顿海的边缘。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: You almost can't see across.
sentences.zh: 你几乎看不到对岸。

sentences.en: And we're just at the tip.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在才刚到边缘。

sentences.en: It's pretty narrow here.
sentences.zh: 这里挺窄的。

sentences.en: Reporter Emmett Fitzgerald recently visited the Salton Sea on a hot summer day in the desert.
sentences.zh: 记者埃梅特·菲茨杰拉德最近在沙漠炎热的夏日访问了索尔顿海。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's just a mile to 107 right now.
sentences.zh: 对，现在离107号公路只有一英里了。

sentences.en: The water is twice as salty as the Pacific Ocean.
sentences.zh: 这里的海水咸度是太平洋的两倍。

sentences.en: The only fish that can live there are tilapia, and even they struggle sometimes.
sentences.zh: 唯一能在这里生存的鱼类是罗非鱼，而且有时它们也很艰难。

sentences.en: There's just a line of dead fish, dead tilapia.
sentences.zh: 有一整排死鱼，都是死罗非鱼。

sentences.en: And then, oh my god, there's flies everywhere.
sentences.zh: 然后，天哪，到处都是苍蝇。

sentences.en: The ground beneath the southern end of the sea is volcanic,
sentences.zh: 湖泊南端下方的地面是火山地带，

sentences.en: and boiling water bubbles to the surface in muddy pools.
sentences.zh: 沸腾的水在泥潭中冒着泡泡涌出地表。

sentences.en: It feels post-apocalyptic and prehistoric, all at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉既像是末日浩劫后，又像是史前时代。

sentences.en: But it's also weirdly beautiful.
sentences.zh: 但它也有一种诡异的美感。

sentences.en: And the sea isn't dead.
sentences.zh: 而且这片海并不是死的。

sentences.en: The water is teeming with microbial life,
sentences.zh: 水里充满了微生物，

sentences.en: and the beaches are covered with sandpipers, egrets, and pelicans.
sentences.zh: 海滩上到处都是鹬、白鹭和鹈鹕。

sentences.en: This sea, this gurgling, sometimes stinky, accident of a sea,
sentences.zh: 这片海，这个咕咕作响、有时散发恶臭、由意外造成的海洋，

sentences.en: is actually in danger of drying up and disappearing.
sentences.zh: 其实正面临干涸和消失的危险。

sentences.en: And you may be thinking,
sentences.zh: 你可能在想，

sentences.en: good riddance, it doesn't sound all that nice.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，听起来不怎么样嘛。

sentences.en: And you wouldn't be alone.
sentences.zh: 你绝不是唯一这么想的人。

sentences.en: Over the years, it's been hard to get people to care about saving the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 这些年来，很难让人去关心拯救索尔顿海的事。

sentences.en: In part, because it doesn't seem natural enough.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，它看起来不够天然。

sentences.en: In general, we tend to think about places and objects as either natural or unnatural.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我们倾向于将地方和物体视为天然的或非天然的。

sentences.en: Forest, natural.
sentences.zh: 森林，天然的。

sentences.en: City, unnatural.
sentences.zh: 城市，非天然的。

sentences.en: But that black and white distinction is sometimes grayer than it seeMs.
sentences.zh: 但这种非黑即白的界限有时比看上去的更模糊。

sentences.en: Today, peregrine falcons are nesting on skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 如今，游隼在摩天大楼上筑巢。

sentences.en: Coral reefs are growing on oil derricks.
sentences.zh: 珊瑚礁在石油钻井平台上生长。

sentences.en: And some seemingly wild ecosystems are carefully managed by humans.
sentences.zh: 一些看似野生的生态系统其实由人类精心管理。

sentences.en: The truth is, a lot of places on Earth are the messy result of a combination of natural and unnatural events.
sentences.zh: 事实是，地球上的许多地方都是自然与非自然事件交织出的混乱产物。

sentences.en: Nowhere is messier than the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 没有哪里比索尔顿海更混乱了。

sentences.en: And it raises the question,
sentences.zh: 这就引发了一个问题，

sentences.en: should we protect an ecosystem that's not purely natural?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该保护一个并非纯天然的生态系统？

sentences.en: The Salton Sink has not always been full of water,
sentences.zh: 索尔顿盆地并非一直装满了水，

sentences.en: but it hasn't always been empty either.
sentences.zh: 但它也并非一直空着。

sentences.en: Over centuries, the meandering Colorado River would periodically flow into the sink and fill it with water.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，蜿蜒的科罗拉多河会定期流入盆地并将其注满水。

sentences.en: And then over time, the water would dry up.
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，水分会蒸发干涸。

sentences.en: This cycle repeated itself every 400 or 500 years or so.
sentences.zh: 这个循环每四五百年重复一次。

sentences.en: But when white settlers showed up in the desert in the late 1800s,
sentences.zh: 但当19世纪末白人定居者来到沙漠时，

sentences.en: there was no sea there at all.
sentences.zh: 那里根本没有海。

sentences.en: Just a parched basin.
sentences.zh: 只有一个干涸的盆地。

sentences.en: A trough.
sentences.zh: 一个凹地。

sentences.en: 270 feet below sea level at its deepeSt.
sentences.zh: 最深处低于海平面270英尺。

sentences.en: And filled with natural salt deposits,
sentences.zh: 里面充满了天然盐矿，

sentences.en: which companies harvested to sell in cities like San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 各公司将其开采并在旧金山等城市出售。

sentences.en: But frontier developers soon realized that if you brought in water,
sentences.zh: 但前线开发商很快意识到，如果你把水引进来，

sentences.en: you could grow crops 12 months a year under the desert sun.
sentences.zh: 你就能在沙漠的烈日下一年12个月种植农作物。

sentences.en: So they set about rebranding this place as an agricultural paradise.
sentences.zh: 于是他们着手将这个地方重新包装成一个农业天堂。

sentences.en: And they started by getting rid of the name Salton Sink.
sentences.zh: 他们首先去掉了“索尔顿盆地”这个名字。

sentences.en: Well, that's not a very appealing name if you're trying to sell lots.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果你想卖地，这个名字可不太吸引人。

sentences.en: So they thought of Imperial Valley.
sentences.zh: 于是他们想到了“帝王谷”。

sentences.en: It sounded great.
sentences.zh: 听起来很棒。

sentences.en: That's Pat Laughlin.
sentences.zh: 那是帕特·洛克林。

sentences.en: She's a local historian who's lived in the area for the last 60 years.
sentences.zh: 她是一位当地历史学家，已经在该地区生活了60年。

sentences.en: They established a water company,
sentences.zh: 他们成立了一家水务公司，

sentences.en: which would bring water by canal from the Colorado River.
sentences.zh: 通过运河从科罗拉多河引水。

sentences.en: They said, if you start a farm here, we'll bring you the water.
sentences.zh: 他们说，如果你在这里开办农场，我们就给你引水。

sentences.en: This water came into Imperial Valley and watered the acreage.
sentences.zh: 这些水流入帝王谷并灌溉了土地。

sentences.en: And these real estate developers sold a lot of lots in Europe
sentences.zh: 这些房地产开发商在欧洲卖出了很多地块，

sentences.en: to people who wanted to come to America and get a new start.
sentences.zh: 卖给那些想去美国重新开始的人。

sentences.en: And they had a wonderful agricultural industry going down there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里开展了蓬勃的农业产业。

sentences.en: For a few years anyway.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，持续了几年。

sentences.en: In 1905, the water company cut a new canal.
sentences.zh: 1905年，水务公司开挖了一条新运河。

sentences.en: And before they had time to reinforce it.
sentences.zh: 还没来得及加固它，

sentences.en: They had a very late flood upriver in the Colorado.
sentences.zh: 上游的科罗拉多河就发生了非常晚的洪水。

sentences.en: And the water just came through and washed out that cut and flooded the valley.
sentences.zh: 河水直接冲垮了那个豁口，淹没了山谷。

sentences.en: Water broke through the wall of the canal and poured into the Salton Sink,
sentences.zh: 水冲破了运河的堤岸，倾泻进索尔顿盆地，

sentences.en: destroying farms and homes.
sentences.zh: 摧毁了农场和家园。

sentences.en: It was a disaster.
sentences.zh: 这是一场灾难。

sentences.en: And it just kept pouring in.
sentences.zh: 而且水还在不断涌入。

sentences.en: The federal government could not be bothered to help.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府懒得提供帮助。

sentences.en: So the task of stopping the flow of water fell mostly to the Southern Pacific Railway,
sentences.zh: 因此，阻止水流的任务主要落在了南太平洋铁路公司身上，

sentences.en: which had lost train tracks in the flood and would lose more if they did nothing.
sentences.zh: 它在洪水中损失了铁轨，如果什么都不做还会损失更多。

sentences.en: It was an amazing task.
sentences.zh: 这是一项了不起的任务。

sentences.en: They built railroad tracks out to the break in the dike.
sentences.zh: 他们在溃口处修建了铁轨。

sentences.en: And then they just took flat car loads of cement and old cars or any junk that they could throw in
sentences.zh: 然后他们用平板车运来水泥、旧汽车或任何他们能扔进去的垃圾，

sentences.en: because there was just no solid bottom there to the river.
sentences.zh: 因为河底根本没有坚实的基底。

sentences.en: It was all sandy.
sentences.zh: 全都是沙子。

sentences.en: They did this for an entire year until they finally managed to fill in the breach
sentences.zh: 他们这样干了整整一年，直到最终设法堵住缺口，

sentences.en: and get the river back into its channel.
sentences.zh: 让河流回到河道中。

sentences.en: But by that point, the water had filled up the Salton Sink,
sentences.zh: 但到了那个时候，水已经填满了索尔顿盆地，

sentences.en: creating a massive lake in the middle of the desert.
sentences.zh: 在沙漠中央形成了一个巨大的湖泊。

sentences.en: The Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海。

sentences.en: And most people assumed it would just dry up like a puddle on a hot day.
sentences.zh: 大多数人以为它会像热天里的水坑一样干涸。

sentences.en: Which is what it usually did whenever the Colorado flowed into the Salton Sink.
sentences.zh: 每当科罗拉多河流入索尔顿盆地时，通常都是这样的结果。

sentences.en: But the sea had a new water source this time.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，这片海有了新的水源。

sentences.en: Agriculture.
sentences.zh: 农业。

sentences.en: As irrigation flowed off the fields in the Imperial Valley,
sentences.zh: 当灌溉水从帝王谷的田地流出时，

sentences.en: it ran downhill into the sink and sustained the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 它顺着山坡流入盆地，维持了索尔顿海的存在。

sentences.en: And for much of the 20th century, the runoff coming into the sea
sentences.zh: 在整个20世纪的大部分时间里，流入海里的径流量

sentences.en: was about the same as the amount of water being lost to evaporation,
sentences.zh: 大约等于因蒸发而损失的水量，

sentences.en: creating a strange balance that made the sea appear stable.
sentences.zh: 形成了一种奇妙的平衡，使海面看起来很稳定。

sentences.en: And back then, the sea was pretty different than it is now.
sentences.zh: 而在当时，海的面貌与现在大不相同。

sentences.en: It looked like a peaceful oasis in an otherwise hostile desert,
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是一个荒凉沙漠中的平静绿洲，

sentences.en: like somewhere you might want to go on vacation.
sentences.zh: 就像你想去度假的地方。

sentences.en: In the 1950s, a new round of developers saw a chance to turn the sea
sentences.zh: 20世纪50年代，新一轮的开发商看到了将这片海

sentences.en: into a playground for Los Angeles weekenders.
sentences.zh: 变成洛杉矶周末度假者游乐场的机会。

sentences.en: They called it the California Riviera.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为加利福尼亚的里维埃拉。

sentences.en: Here is truly a miracle in the desert.
sentences.zh: 这里真的是沙漠中的奇迹。

sentences.en: A whole new outlet for the crowded millions in big cities.
sentences.zh: 为大城市中拥挤的数百万人口提供了一个全新去处。

sentences.en: A palm springs with water.
sentences.zh: 一个有水的棕榈泉。

sentences.en: Here is where you can find the good life in the sun.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你可以找到阳光下的美好生活。

sentences.en: Today, the Salton River...
sentences.zh: 今天，索尔顿河……

sentences.en: An oil tycoon named Penn Phillips built a planned community
sentences.zh: 一个名叫彭·菲利普斯的石油大亨在湖的西侧

sentences.en: on the west side of the lake called Salton City.
sentences.zh: 建立了一个名为索尔顿城的规划社区。

sentences.en: He put in a yacht club over there and laid out lots and sold lots
sentences.zh: 他在那里建了一个游艇俱乐部，划分了地块并出售地块，

sentences.en: and brought busloads of people down to see the sea and purchase lots.
sentences.zh: 用巴士载着人们来看海并购买地块。

sentences.en: But that's Pat Laughlin again.
sentences.zh: 又是帕特·洛克林在说话。

sentences.en: She used to take her family to the Salton Sea on weekends.
sentences.zh: 她过去常常在周末带家人去索尔顿海。

sentences.en: It was really a wonderful place to go for recreation when I first came in 1950.
sentences.zh: 当我1950年刚来的时候，这里真的是个度假的好地方。

sentences.en: And I have memories of many hamburger fries on the beach and swimming.
sentences.zh: 我记得在海滩上吃过很多次汉堡、游过泳。

sentences.en: But the water was great and there was water skiing
sentences.zh: 那里的水很好，可以玩滑水，

sentences.en: and they had a lot of boat races across the sea and back.
sentences.zh: 他们还在海里举办了很多次往返的划船比赛。

sentences.en: And then there were the fish.
sentences.zh: 然后是鱼类。

sentences.en: The California Department of Fish and Game decided to stock the sea with fish
sentences.zh: 加州渔猎局决定在海里放养鱼类

sentences.en: in order to encourage more tourism.
sentences.zh: 以促进更多旅游业。

sentences.en: Scientists at UCLA worked to design an ecosystem that could handle year-round sport fishing.
sentences.zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校的科学家们致力于设计一个能够应对全年运动垂钓的生态系统。

sentences.en: And they had to establish a whole food chain to get the larger game fish to survive.
sentences.zh: 他们必须建立完整的食物链来让大型游钓鱼生存下来。

sentences.en: But they started with the little brine shrimp
sentences.zh: 但他们从小的卤虫开始，

sentences.en: and they brought them up from the Gulf of Baja California
sentences.zh: 把它们从下加利福尼亚湾带过来，

sentences.en: and they brought in the brine fish and then whatever the...
sentences.zh: 他们带来了盐水鱼，然后无论什么……

sentences.en: eight brine fish came and then the next thing up the chain.
sentences.zh: 八种盐水鱼来了，然后是食物链上的下一级。

sentences.en: The water was salty, but not too salty.
sentences.zh: 水是咸的，但不太咸。

sentences.en: And so they tried a mix of freshwater and saltwater species.
sentences.zh: 所以他们尝试了淡水和咸水物种的组合。

sentences.en: And a lot of this work was done by biologists.
sentences.zh: 这其中很大一部分工作是由生物学家完成的。

sentences.en: But some of it was just renegade fishermen.
sentences.zh: 但其中一部分只是一些不守规矩的渔民干的。

sentences.en: They tried all kinds of fish.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了各种各样的鱼。

sentences.en: They tried harbor seals and they survived, I guess, for a while.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试了港海豹，我想它们存活了一段时间。

sentences.en: But after a while, they didn't see any of them anymore.
sentences.zh: 但过了一段时间，再也看不到它们的踪影了。

sentences.en: That's Steve Horvitz, a retired ranger with the California State Parks.
sentences.zh: 那是史蒂夫·霍维茨，加州州立公园的退休巡护员。

sentences.en: Spent about 10 years down at the Salton Sea living in the desert.
sentences.zh: 在索尔顿海的沙漠里生活了大约10年。

sentences.en: Steve says that a few fish like tilapia, sargo, and corvina thrived.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫说，罗非鱼、萨戈鱼和科维纳鱼等少数鱼类繁衍兴旺。

sentences.en: And by the 1960s, the Salton Sea was one of the most popular fishing destinations in the country.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪60年代，索尔顿海成为全国最受欢迎的垂钓胜地之一。

sentences.en: The marinas were full of boaters.
sentences.zh: 码头上挤满了乘船的人。

sentences.en: The marinas were full of life and the bars were full and it was packed.
sentences.zh: 码头上充满生机，酒吧里人满为患。

sentences.en: They were a run of cars, you know, coming from the L.A.
sentences.zh: 你知道，每逢周末，

sentences.en: area down to the Salton Sea every weekend.
sentences.zh: 都有车流从洛杉矶地区驶向索尔顿海。

sentences.en: Stars like the Beach Boys and Frank Sinatra tooled around the lake in motorboats.
sentences.zh: 海滩男孩和弗兰克·辛纳屈等明星也开着摩托艇在湖上游玩。

sentences.en: And they gave concerts and programs on the shore of the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 他们还在索尔顿海畔举办音乐会和节目。

sentences.en: It was a place to go.
sentences.zh: 那是一个必去的地方。

sentences.en: There was a time when more people went to the Salton Sea than went to Yosemite.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，去索尔顿海的人比去约塞米蒂国家公园的人还要多。

sentences.en: But the good life in the sun didn't last all that long.
sentences.zh: 然而，阳光下的美好生活并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: In the 70s and 80s, floods knocked out a lot of the infrastructure along the shoreline.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪70和80年代，洪水摧毁了海岸线附近的大量基础设施。

sentences.en: And most of the owners of the marinas and the yacht clubs decided not to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 码头和游艇俱乐部的大多数所有者决定不再重建。

sentences.en: You know, by then people began thinking that, you know, maybe there were more issues than they were aware with the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 你知道，到那时人们开始觉得，关于索尔顿海，可能存在比他们意识到的更多的问题。

sentences.en: And they were right.
sentences.zh: 他们想得没错。

sentences.en: One of the biggest issues was salinity.
sentences.zh: 最大的问题之一是盐度。

sentences.en: The water entering the Salton Sea picks up salts from the soil.
sentences.zh: 流入索尔顿海的水带走了土壤中的盐分。

sentences.en: And those salts have nowhere to go.
sentences.zh: 而这些盐分无处可去。

sentences.en: Salton Sea is a closed body of water.
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海是一个内陆封闭水体。

sentences.en: The only way water leaves is it evaporates.
sentences.zh: 水离开这里的唯一途径就是蒸发。

sentences.en: And as water evaporates, the material, the solids stay.
sentences.zh: 随着水分蒸发，物质和固体留了下来。

sentences.en: And so the salt concentration continues to increase and increase and increase.
sentences.zh: 因此，盐分浓度不断增加、增加、再增加。

sentences.en: Every year, the sea gets saltier and saltier, which is a natural process for lakes with no outlet.
sentences.zh: 每年，这个湖变得越来越咸，对于没有出水口的湖泊来说，这是一个自然过程。

sentences.en: But tourists didn't like super salty water, smelly fish die-offs, and massive algae blooMs.
sentences.zh: 但游客们并不喜欢超咸的水、恶臭的鱼类死亡事件以及大规模的藻类爆发。

sentences.en: By the 1990s, most of the marinas and hotels had closed their doors.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪90年代，大多数码头和酒店都已关门歇业。

sentences.en: And a lot of people had left town.
sentences.zh: 许多人也已经离开了小镇。

sentences.en: A rugged contingent stuck it out in small seaside towns.
sentences.zh: 一小群坚韧的人留在了海滨小镇。

sentences.en: But the dream of the California Riviera was over.
sentences.zh: 但加州里维埃拉的梦想已经破灭。

sentences.en: And then in the mid-90s, the sea began to dry up.
sentences.zh: 然后在90年代中期，海水开始干涸。

sentences.en: Remember, pretty much the only water going into the sea was from agricultural runoff.
sentences.zh: 记住，注入海里的几乎唯一的水源就是农业径流。

sentences.en: But over the years, farms had become more efficient with water.
sentences.zh: 但多年来，农场在用水方面变得更有效率。

sentences.en: They installed drip irrigation systems that reduced the runoff draining into the sea.
sentences.zh: 他们安装了滴灌系统，减少了流入大海的径流。

sentences.en: Then in 2003, as part of a complicated water deal,
sentences.zh: 然后在2003年，作为一项复杂的供水协议的一部分，

sentences.en: the water district in Imperial Valley sold off the rights to a lot of their water, mostly to San Diego.
sentences.zh: 帝王谷的水务区出售了他们大部分水资源的使用权，主要卖给了圣迭戈。

sentences.en: Some farmers in the area had to stop watering their fields,
sentences.zh: 当地的一些农民不得不停止给农田浇水，

sentences.en: which meant less water draining into the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 这意味着流入索尔顿海水量减少。

sentences.en: Steve Horvitz and many other local people fought hard against the water transfer,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·霍尔维茨和许多当地人奋力抗争，反对这项水权转让，

sentences.en: which they say was done without a proper environmental review.
sentences.zh: 他们称此举是在没有进行适当的环境评估的情况下完成的。

sentences.en: They lobbied politicians in Sacramento and Washington,
sentences.zh: 他们在萨克拉门托和华盛顿游说政治家，

sentences.en: demanding a plan for saving the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 要求制定拯救索尔顿海的计划。

sentences.en: But few lawmakers wanted to prioritize a fading tourist destination.
sentences.zh: 但很少有立法者愿意优先考虑一个正在衰落的旅游胜地。

sentences.en: In the 90s, celebrity congressman Sonny Bono had been a champion for the sea.
sentences.zh: 在90年代，知名国会议员索尼·博诺曾是该海域的坚定捍卫者。

sentences.en: But he died in a ski accident in 1998.
sentences.zh: 但他在1998年的一次滑雪事故中丧生。

sentences.en: Steve Horvitz says that he even had trouble getting help from environmental groups.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫·霍尔维茨表示，他甚至很难从环保组织那里获得帮助。

sentences.en: Some environmentalists that I knew, they would discount the Salton Sea and say,
sentences.zh: 我认识的一些环保主义者会轻视索尔顿海，并说，

sentences.en: yeah, it's just a wasted body of water.
sentences.zh: 对，这只是一个浪费掉的水体。

sentences.en: It's just a man-made lake.
sentences.zh: 这只是一个人工湖。

sentences.en: And so why are you so worried about it?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么还要这么担心它呢？

sentences.en: And I was amazed by that.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到很惊讶。

sentences.en: You know, many people talk to us about why I restored the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 你知道，许多人跟我们谈论为什么要恢复索尔顿海。

sentences.en: It was an accident.
sentences.zh: 那是一场意外。

sentences.en: That's Bruce Wilcox.
sentences.zh: 那是布鲁斯·威爾科克斯。

sentences.en: I'm the assistant secretary for a natural resource agency in charge of Salton Sea policy.
sentences.zh: 我是负责索尔顿海政策的自然资源机构的助理秘书长。

sentences.en: And Bruce takes issue with people who call it an accidental sea.
sentences.zh: 布鲁斯对人们称其为“意外之海”的说法持有异议。

sentences.en: This latest version of the Salton Sea was an accident,
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海的这个最新版本是一场意外，

sentences.en: but there's lots of geologic history that shows that the Imperial Valley was flooded
sentences.zh: 但有大量的地质历史表明，帝王谷曾

sentences.en: periodically by the Colorado River.
sentences.zh: 周期性地被科罗拉多河淹没。

sentences.en: Either way, wildlife doesn't really care whether or not the lake is an accident.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，野生动物并不真正在乎这个湖是不是意外形成的。

sentences.en: Just look at all the birds.
sentences.zh: 看看那些鸟类就知道了。

sentences.en: Ducks, geese, stilts, and douchers, heron, brown pelican, and white pelicans,
sentences.zh: 野鸭、大雁、高跷鹬、秋沙鸭、苍鹭、褐鹈鹕和白鹈鹕，

sentences.en: a large population of white pelicans.
sentences.zh: 庞大的白鹈鹕种群。

sentences.en: There are about 425 different species that have been cataloged or identified at the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 在索尔顿海已经编目或识别出了大约425种不同的鸟类。

sentences.en: Aside from the Texas Gulf, the Salton Sea has more bird species than any other place in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 除了德克萨斯湾，索尔顿海拥有的鸟类物种比美国其他任何地方都多。

sentences.en: Many of those birds migrate up and down North America,
sentences.zh: 其中许多鸟类在北美南北迁徙，

sentences.en: and the birds would stop at marshes in Southern California to refuel.
sentences.zh: 这些鸟会在南加州的沼泽地停留补充体力。

sentences.en: But those marshes aren't there anymore.
sentences.zh: 但那些沼泽已经不复存在了。

sentences.en: Most of the wetlands in Southern California, or actually probably in all of California,
sentences.zh: 南加州的大部分湿地，或者说实际上可能是整个加州的湿地，

sentences.en: have disappeared because of development of one kind or another.
sentences.zh: 由于这样或那样的开发都已经消失了。

sentences.en: The Salton Sea is one of the last stops they have.
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海是它们仅存的几站之一。

sentences.en: So if we lose that link, if it dries up, I'm afraid we'll crash a lot of bird populations.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果我们失去这个节点，如果它干涸了，我担心我们会导致许多鸟类种群崩溃。

sentences.en: And there's another reason not to let the sea evaporate.
sentences.zh: 还有一个不让海水蒸发的理由。

sentences.en: Probably the most compelling reason is human health.
sentences.zh: 可能最令人信服的理由是人类健康。

sentences.en: As the sea recedes, it exposes dry lakebed, called playa.
sentences.zh: 随着海水退去，露出了干涸的湖床，被称为普拉亚盐滩。

sentences.en: And it's made up of tiny dust particles that can get into your lungs
sentences.zh: 它由微小的尘埃颗粒组成，这些颗粒会进入你的肺部

sentences.en: and cause respiratory diseases, like asthma.
sentences.zh: 并引发呼吸系统疾病，比如哮喘。

sentences.en: To make matters worse, heavy metals and other toxins from all that agricultural runoff
sentences.zh: 雪上加霜的是，来自所有这些农业径流的重金属和其他毒素

sentences.en: have settled at the bottom of the lake.
sentences.zh: 已经沉淀在湖底。

sentences.en: So there's a tremendous health risk.
sentences.zh: 所以存在巨大的健康风险。

sentences.en: And not just for people living near the sea.
sentences.zh: 而且不仅仅是对住在海边的人来说。

sentences.en: Toxic dust could get blown as far away as Phoenix, Arizona.
sentences.zh: 有毒粉尘可能会被吹到远至亚利桑那州菲尼克斯的地方。

sentences.en: The Pacific Institute, a water think tank in Oakland,
sentences.zh: 位于奥克兰的水务智库太平洋研究所

sentences.en: wrote a report in 2014 saying that the cost of doing nothing at the Salton Sea
sentences.zh: 在2014年发布了一份报告，称对索尔顿海什么都不做的代价

sentences.en: could be as high as $70 billion over the next 30 years.
sentences.zh: 在未来30年内可能高达700亿美元。

sentences.en: As part of that 2003 water transfer,
sentences.zh: 作为2003年水权转让协议的一部分，

sentences.en: California agreed to send some water to the Salton Sea for a few years
sentences.zh: 加州同意在几年内向索尔顿海输送一些水，

sentences.en: to keep the salinity in check while they figure out a solution to the dust and the birds.
sentences.zh: 在他们找到解决灰尘和鸟类问题的方案的同时控制盐度。

sentences.en: That water will stop flowing after 2017.
sentences.zh: 这些水流将在2017年后停止。

sentences.en: But there is a little glimmer of hope.
sentences.zh: 但还是有一丝希望的。

sentences.en: This year, California approved $80 million for a new Salton Sea task force,
sentences.zh: 今年，加州批准了8000万美元用于一个新的索尔顿海工作组，

sentences.en: which Bruce Wilcox heads up.
sentences.zh: 由布鲁斯·威爾科克斯领导。

sentences.en: And they're using the funds to start designing ways to keep the dust down
sentences.zh: 他们正在利用这些资金开始设计方法来减少扬尘

sentences.en: and the birds coming back,
sentences.zh: 并让鸟类回归，

sentences.en: all using a lot less water.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都使用了少得多的水。

sentences.en: The plan is basically to build artificial wetlands,
sentences.zh: 该计划基本上是建造人工湿地，

sentences.en: with water cycling between ponds of varying salinity levels,
sentences.zh: 水在不同盐度水平的池塘之间循环，

sentences.en: each designed to support different bird species.
sentences.zh: 每个池塘都旨在支持不同的鸟类物种。

sentences.en: And there will be walkways and boat launches,
sentences.zh: 并且会有步行道和船只下水坡道，

sentences.en: so people can enjoy the resource too.
sentences.zh: 这样人们也可以享受这些资源。

sentences.en: But there's no blueprint for this kind of ecosystem architecture.
sentences.zh: 但这种生态系统架构并没有蓝图可循。

sentences.en: And planning an ecosystem runs counter to a pretty basic ecological principle
sentences.zh: 规划一个生态系统违背了一个相当基础的生态学原则，

sentences.en: that nature knows beSt.
sentences.zh: 即自然最懂。

sentences.en: For a lot of environments, the best approach is to keep humans as far away as possible.
sentences.zh: 对于许多环境来说，最好的方法是让人类离得越远越好。

sentences.en: But it's too late for that at the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 但对索尔顿海来说，这已经太晚了。

sentences.en: Humans have transformed this landscape,
sentences.zh: 人类已经改变了这个景观，

sentences.en: really the entire Colorado River Basin, in such profound ways.
sentences.zh: 实际上是整个科罗拉多河流域，以如此深远的方式。

sentences.en: We dammed up the river and irrigated the desert.
sentences.zh: 我们筑坝拦河，灌溉了沙漠。

sentences.en: We have dried up all the wetlands.
sentences.zh: 我们已经让所有湿地干涸。

sentences.en: We have made all these modifications, for better or worse.
sentences.zh: 无论好坏，我们已经做出了所有这些改变。

sentences.en: And now we're in a position where we have to step in and manage.
sentences.zh: 现在我们处于必须介入并进行管理的境地。

sentences.en: That's Bruce Wilcox again, the Assistant Secretary for Salton Sea Policy.
sentences.zh: 那是布鲁斯·威爾科克斯，索尔顿海政策助理秘书长。

sentences.en: And I would be lying to you if I didn't say I was a little nervous about that,
sentences.zh: 如果我说对此我没有感到一丝紧张，那我就是在撒谎，

sentences.en: because we don't know anywhere near as much as we think we know.
sentences.zh: 因为我们对它的了解远没有我们想象的那么多。

sentences.en: It's just a little bit arrogant to think we screwed it all up,
sentences.zh: 认为我们把一切都搞砸了，

sentences.en: and then suddenly we decide we can fix it.
sentences.zh: 然后突然又决定我们能修好它，这未免有点傲慢。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a danger in that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这其中存在危险。

sentences.en: But we're in a position where we don't have a choice.
sentences.zh: 但我们处在别无选择的境地。

sentences.en: Building hundreds of acres of artificial wetlands
sentences.zh: 建造数百英亩的人工湿地

sentences.en: is going to require a lot of money, much more than the $80 million they just got.
sentences.zh: 需要大量的资金，远不止他们刚刚得到的8000万美元。

sentences.en: And that means California is going to have to start valuing a landscape
sentences.zh: 这意味着加州将不得不开始重视一片

sentences.en: that's the furthest thing from pristine.
sentences.zh: 与原始状态相去甚远的景观。

sentences.en: It's easy to contrast the Salton Sea with California's second largest body of water,
sentences.zh: 很容易将索尔顿海与加州第二大水体进行对比，

sentences.en: Lake Tahoe, the beautiful blue mountain lake
sentences.zh: 那就是太浩湖，那片美丽的蓝色山间湖泊，

sentences.en: that Northern California yuppies and hippies and yuppies who used to be hippies
sentences.zh: 北加州的雅皮士、嬉皮士以及曾经是嬉皮士的雅皮士们

sentences.en: flock to every weekend.
sentences.zh: 每个周末都蜂拥而至。

sentences.en: Tahoe is sexy.
sentences.zh: 太浩湖很有吸引力。

sentences.en: You know, there's no doubt.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是毫无疑问的。

sentences.en: But this is it.
sentences.zh: 但这就是全部了。

sentences.en: Former park ranger Steve Horvitz.
sentences.zh: 前公园管理员史蒂夫·霍尔维茨。

sentences.en: The Salton Sea is an ugly guy living down there in a desert.
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海就像一个住在沙漠里的丑陋家伙。

sentences.en: A hot and sweaty guy that many times just repels people.
sentences.zh: 一个闷热流汗的家伙，很多时候只会让人退避三舍。

sentences.en: And that Salton Sea will never be a Lake Tahoe.
sentences.zh: 而且索尔顿海永远不会成为太浩湖。

sentences.en: But it'll have its own beauty.
sentences.zh: 但它会有它自己的美。

sentences.en: Everywhere you go in California, there are bumper stickers that say,
sentences.zh: 在加州，无论你走到哪里，都有这样的汽车贴纸：

sentences.en: Keep Tahoe Blue.
sentences.zh: “保持太浩湖蔚蓝”。

sentences.en: It's almost a badge of environmentalism out here.
sentences.zh: 这在这里几乎成了环保主义的象征。

sentences.en: The Salton Sea might not be as beautiful or as natural as Lake Tahoe,
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海可能不像太浩湖那样美丽或自然，

sentences.en: but we need it all the same.
sentences.zh: 但我们同样需要它。

sentences.en: But if the Salton Sea is going to get saved, it'll need to get appreciated firSt.
sentences.zh: 但如果索尔顿海要得救，首先得有人欣赏它。

sentences.en: We're going to need to see some of them bumper stickers.
sentences.zh: 我们需要看到其中一些汽车贴纸。

sentences.en: We've just got to think of a slogan.
sentences.zh: 我们只是得想出一个标语。

sentences.en: And it probably can't be,
sentences.zh: 而且大概不能是：

sentences.en: Save the hot, sweaty guy in the desert.
sentences.zh: “拯救沙漠里那个闷热流汗的家伙”。

sentences.en: So, um, let's see.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，让我想想。

sentences.en: Uh, see you at the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 呃，索尔顿海见。

sentences.en: Make the Salton Sea great again.
sentences.zh: 让索尔顿海再次伟大。

sentences.en: Redesign the Riviera.
sentences.zh: 重塑里维埃拉。

sentences.en: The Salton Sea is for the birds.
sentences.zh: 索尔顿海是属于鸟类的。

sentences.en: We came, we saw the Salton Sea.
sentences.zh: 我们来了，我们看到了索尔顿海。

sentences.en: Maintain the mistake.
sentences.zh: 保持这个错误。

sentences.en: Don't add salt in the wound.
sentences.zh: 伤口上别再撒盐了。

sentences.en: Keep God on your right shoulder and salt in on your left.
sentences.zh: 让上帝在你的右肩，盐在你的左肩。

sentences.en: Tilapia, I hardly know ya.
sentences.zh: 罗非鱼，我几乎不认识你。

sentences.en: That's the one.
sentences.zh: 就是这个。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Emmett Fitzgerald,
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由埃米特·菲茨杰拉德制作，

sentences.en: with Sharif Youssef, Katie Mingle,
sentences.zh: 合作者有谢里夫·尤oussef、凯蒂·明格，

sentences.en: Kurt Kohlstedt, Sam Greenspan,
sentences.zh: 库尔特·科尔施泰特、萨姆·格林斯潘，

sentences.en: Avery Truffelman, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 艾弗里·特鲁夫曼，以及我，罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: Some of the music in this episode was provided by our friends at OK Akumi from Hell Audio.
sentences.zh: 本集中的部分音乐由我们来自Hell Audio的OK Akumi的朋友提供。

sentences.en: OK Akumi have a new four-song EP that I just bought yesterday.
sentences.zh: OK Akumi有一张四首歌的新EP，我昨天刚买。

sentences.en: It's on Bandcamp.
sentences.zh: 它在Bandcamp上。

sentences.en: It's called Sea Land Sky.
sentences.zh: 节目名叫“海陆空”。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7 KALW San Francisco and produced on Radio Row
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山 91.7 KALW 电台的项目，制作于

sentences.en: in beautiful downtown Oakland, California.
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州奥克兰市美丽的市中心“无线电街”。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在 Facebook 上找到并喜欢这个节目。

sentences.en: Follow all the people who work on this show on Twitter and Instagram.
sentences.zh: 在 Twitter 和 Instagram 上关注所有参与这个节目制作的人。

sentences.en: But the best way to explore the 99% Invisible activity that shapes the design of our world
sentences.zh: 但探索塑造我们世界设计的 99% Invisible 活动的最好方式

sentences.en: is to click around the hundreds and hundreds of stories on 99pi.org.
sentences.zh: 是在 99pi.org 上浏览数以百计的故事。
